eyebrow: A security activity layered onto every SDLC stage
code:
Plan      -> security requirements, not an afterthought
Design    -> threat model the architecture (STRIDE)
Develop   -> secure coding + static analysis + review
Build/Test-> SAST, dependency, secrets, IaC scanning
Release   -> policy gate before a build ships
Deploy    -> least-privilege identity, vaulted secrets
Operate   -> monitoring, audit logging, incident response
caption: The SSDLC: the same plan-design-develop-test-deploy-operate flow, with security woven into each stage.
